scope: Restored queue with two authenticated synthetic clients in a local E2EE-enabled LiveKit room
result: Reorder and remove propagated to the other client through the production WebSocket handler; stale revision returned 409, exact replay preserved revision, and Stop succeeded. The durable database then held no session, revision 4 and four receipts.
fixture_correction: An initial attempt stopped on a premature client participant-count assertion. The successful run checked exact synthetic participant identities against the server roster instead, because client roster visibility is asynchronous.
limitations: The queue was seeded in an isolated database. No playback, actual hardware or full HiChat UI was used; this is not full music or device acceptance. Test resources were cleaned up.
